Essentially it was my job to be the social media "expert" and get corporate clients to sign up for our services. Anyway, one day I meet with this inhouse ad guy for a large corporation. We met at this hotel in Palm Springs, (his choice, I dunno, not that unusual actually but that's neither here nor there). Anyway, this would be huge for the firm if we got them as a client, so I went in with my A game.

This wasn't my first tango, and usually it's about the same thing. I was the "hip social media savvy" 24 year old who can explain social media to this time while simultaneously showing him a good time. And then in the midst of this wreck these two drunk cougars made their move on us. "Whatever" I thought. Their just flirting at a bar, no big, I flirt back. We're having a good time, but then the bar calls last call. Okay, great, I'm exhausted, I'm happy to finally go to bed. My would-be-corporate-client suggests that the four of us take the party up to his room. Never one to refuse more alcohol, regardless of how exhausted I am, I gleefully agree. We go up their, cheerfully singing, arm in arm, being drunk all the way to his room. I walk in expecting shot marathon and more music. BUT what actually happened is after we each drink one of the many shooter bottles in the mini-fridge, corporate client and cougar one start making up. Cougar 2 is now looking at me. This is when it started to really get dicey.

Then I drove out to Palm Springs for this trip. When I say "casual" I mean we hadn't gotten intimate yet. It was a long relationship, and as those go, a tremendously awful breakup, and (rightfully so) we were both nervous about moving too fast. So we were not dating, we hadn't been intimate, we were by no means exclusive, and technically speaking I could have done whatever I wanted and it would have been fair game. That being said, I know she wasn't doing anything with anyone else and that all her figurative marbles were bet on me, (I have no idea how that expression goes but whatever), and I too wanted to bet all my figurative marbles on her. So, I sort of back away, and while she tries to grab me I just kinda go "noooooo, I don't really know if I should do this, sorry, I'm drunk, I've got a thing with a girl back home in LA." that sort of stuff. She gets sort of upset, not yelling or anything, but just, you know, displeased about being turned down and just sits on a bed with her arms crossed while I just stand awkwardly a few feet away. On the other bed my would-be-client and Cougar 1 are feverishly making out still. Then, he opens his eyes and sees cougar too sitting with her arms crossed and stops making out to ask what's wrong. Cougar 2 says something along the lines of "he doesn't wanna do anything. He's with someone or some shit." Cougar 1 looks at me and says something like "oh come on don't be a party pooper" or some shit like that. I say I'm tired and drunk and blah blah blah generic excuses. Then corporate client pulls me out into the hall while saying to room "I'll fix this" (never a good sign).

In the hallway he asks me why I won't "fuck her" (yes, he phrased it like that). I try to explain my weird wannabe-relationship with my ex and how I feel uncomfortable sleeping with another women. He gives all these typical "who cares, it's one night, no one will tell, blah blah blah," all those typical excuses people say to justify trashy hookups. I keep saying generic nos to his generic come ons. finally after a bit of silence he goes "you know I'm married, so I'm not supposed to be doing this either. I would feel a lot more comfortable if I didn't do this alone." (or something to that extent). He basically Serpico'd me, a sort of "I can't break the rules unless you break the rules to, so that I know you won't fuck me over" sort of thing. So I'm suddenly real intimidated because he's my would-be-client and I cave and say okay, but had no intention to follow through, but also had not yet thought up an escape plan because well, I was drunk, and not the best planner at that moment. So he pats me on the back and we walk back in the room, and he says "party time" or some shit like that. Suddenly, it hits me, my escape plan, as I'm walking back in the room staring at these cougars I burst out with - "You know what. I can't get it up. I'm sorry. I'm embarrassed. I didn't wanna say anything, it's not you, you're beautiful, it's been happening for a while, and I just don't know what to do, it doesn't work anymore." Corporate would-be-client is mouth agape because this is not-at-all what I told him in the hallway. Both cougars make the "aww poor baby" moan and hand gesture. Cougar 2 (the one assigned to me, in case it's hard to follow this story), says "oh, I'm sure I can fix that" or some other overly-cocky shit as she approaches me. I back up and say something to the extend of "oh, you won't I've tried everything, I'm sorry, it just will not work." So then she smiles and grabs for her purse and pulls out a pill bottle and says something like "have you tried this." I (stupidly) said no. Corporate man laughs and says something like "shes got your medicine, man." She hands me a pill. Fuck it, I'm cornered, I take the Viagra. I'm literally completely out of plays at this point, fuck it, time for the old disappearing act; a shitty play, I know, but like I said, I'm out of ideas. I realize now that it wouldn't matter at this point, because I'm about to disappear anyway, but I really didn't want any more additional awkwardness, so as she tries to pulls me down to the bed, I ask her if she's ever played with ice during sex, she says no with a curious smirk, I say "hold on, I'll be right back with some ice." I jump off her, she giggles, I run out of the room, everyone thinks I'm getting ice. I go to my room with the intention of just leaving and going to bed, but I suddenly start worrying about them showing up my room and knocking on the door, (corporate would-be-client knows which room is mine). So, in my haze, I ponder the place to go, and the conclusion I came to was jacuzzi. It was a large hotel complex and the pool side of the complex was tropical themed, and the jacuzzis were in this corner covered in palm trees and tiki torches and bamboo and shit. Also, it was like 3 in the morning at this point and I was positive security was done doing rounds down there to clear people out. So I went down to one of the jacuzzis. It was completely abandoned as I presumed, (hotel closes entire pool area at midnight). I lay down next to one of the jacuzzis. I'm getting ready to just fall asleep there, using my jacket as a pillow, suddenly, my body starts feeling weird. I remember this feeling but couldn't place it for a brief moment. Then I realized what was happening to me, I remember this feeling from when I was an undergrad.

She had given me a fucking molly (ecstasy...sort of)

Tripped out for god knows how long next to that fucking jacuzzi in the middle of the night. Woke up the next morning, thankfully before any guests were there, but the custodial/pool set-up staff were looking at me real funny (rightfully so).
